description.text: I make videos about religion from a secular perspective and try to be compassionate in the process. Here you'll find collaborations with scholars of religious studies, essays about religion and psychology, personal stories from my life as a fundamentalist Evangelical Christian turned agnostic/atheist, responses to some religious content, and more.
